feeds.title: Nestlé Purina News Center
feeds.description: Nestlé Purina is a family-friendly and pet-friendly community. This site is an official Nestlé Purina News site where experts share tips on care, feeding, and behavior with fellow pet lovers in the U.S along with the latest press releases.

feeds.title: Nestlé News
feeds.description: Nestlé is the world's largest food and beverage company. Its purpose is enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. The Nestlé Newsfeed is a one-stop-shop for news, press releases, statements, media contacts and other multi-media content about Nestlé.
